notes: Corpus bootstrap (knowledge distillation): a capable model works HELD-OUT tasks; rag_scrape_journal.py keeps only solver-certified iterations as exemplars.

Held out from the of-record experiment by construction: different networks (case118, case_ACTIVSg500, case9mod) and different goal instances. The scraper additionally drops anything from grader_ablation_spec.json networks/goals.
Condition C0-norag only, so the corpus is not built from its own retrievals.

Model: a model OUTSIDE the evaluation set (Amir's choice: Claude Opus 5.5), so the strong-model arm never retrieves its own worked examples. Replace <opus-model-id> with the exact API model ID from your Anthropic console; the runner refuses placeholders. In the paper: 'generated by a model outside the evaluation set' (not 'independent': same model family).

Every goal declares intent guards (same semantics as the evaluator) and states its constraints in its text; rag_scrape_journal.py drops any iteration that violates them, so the corpus never shows a forbidden shortcut.

PFLOW goals on case118 (relieve / voltage) are pending until their stressed variants are pre-checked: voltage -> precheck_cases.py --case ../datafiles/case118.m --apps opflow,pflow --vband 0.95,1.05 --scales 0.8,0.9,1.0; relieve -> precheck_cases.py --case ../datafiles/case118.m --outage-scan 1.0 (then 1.1-1.3 with --agc if needed). Freeze with --write-stressed into rag/tools/specs/cases/, set the paths, add the branch_stays_out guard to the relieve case, remove 'pending'. Until then run with --skip-unimplemented.

Run from the agentigrid project root: python rag/tools/experiment_runner.py --spec rag/tools/specs/corpus_bootstrap_spec.json --skip-unimplemented (set reps to 1 first to measure the per-run cost from the journals' llm_usage).

Relaxed limits (voltage band, line ratings) are not cost savings; goals and guards follow the evaluation spec. Runs made before this rule: re-scrape with --guards-spec rag/tools/specs/corpus_bootstrap_spec.json so the current guards apply to them too.
ACTIVSg500-scopflow (secure_dispatch) removed 2026-09-28: its SCOPFLOW baseline was never feasible in the bootstrap runs, so it produced no exemplars.

case118 pre-check (2026-09-28): voltage task frozen at x1.0 with the 0.95-1.05 pu band written in (PFLOW 3 violations, slack within limits; OPFLOW feasibility within the written band to be confirmed on the frozen file). Relieve moved to ACTIVSg500 because case118 carries no line ratings (rateA = 0 on every branch).

cases.name: ACTIVSg500-pflow-relieve
cases.pending: case118 has no line ratings (rateA = 0, i.e. unlimited), so no outage can overload it; use held-out ACTIVSg500 instead: precheck_cases.py --case ../datafiles/case_ACTIVSg500.m --outage-scan 1.0 (then higher scales with --agc if none), freeze with --write-stressed F [--agc] --outage FBUS-TBUS, set path and a case-level branch_stays_out guard

goals.text: Lower the total generation cost by at least 5% while serving the same load, without changing generator cost curves, and without relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings, staying feasible
Keep every bus voltage between 0.97 and 1.03 pu at the lowest cost you can find, without shedding load or raising line ratings

Take the largest generator out of service and restore a feasible, low-cost operating point while serving the same load, without changing generator cost curves, and without relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings
Determine how much uniform load growth the system tolerates while remaining feasible, testing growth in steps
Obtain a dispatch that stays feasible for every contingency in the contingency file, without shedding load or relaxing bus voltage limits or line ratings, and report its cost
Obtain a contingency-secure dispatch with all bus voltages held between 0.96 and 1.04 pu, without shedding load or raising line ratings
Relieve every overloaded line after the forced branch outage, without shedding load, changing line ratings, or returning the out-of-service branch to service
Bring every bus voltage within 0.95-1.05 pu without shedding load or changing the voltage limits
